Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
1. Short
title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Punjab Education Authorities Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

Incorporation

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
2.
Establishment of Authorities.‑‑‑(1) The Government may
establish such authorities for performing functions in the field of education
as it may deem fit.
Explanation.‑‑In
this Ordinance the expression "authorities" shall include committees
and other agencies.
(2) An
Authority shall be known by such name as may be assigned to it by the
Government.
(3) The
Government may provide that an authority shall be a body corporate having
perpetual succession with power to acquire and hold property and to contract
and that it shall sue and be sued by its name.

Functions

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
3.
Functions.‑‑An Authority shall perform such functions in the
field of education as may be assigned to them by the Government.

Constitution of the Authority

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
4.
Constitution of an Authority.‑‑(1) An Authority may be
constituted in such manner as the Government may determine.
(2) No act
or proceeding of an authority shall be invalid merely on the ground of
existence of any vacancy or defect in the constitution of the authority.

Chief Executive Officer

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
5. Chief
Executive Officer.‑‑(l) The Government may appoint s Chief
Executive Officer of an Authority on such terms and conditions as,
notwithstanding anything contained in any law, the Government may determine.
(2) The
Chief Executive Officer may exercise such powers and perform such functions as
may be prescribed.

Appointment of officers and employees

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
6.
Appointment of Officers and Employees.‑The Government may appoint
such persons in the service of an Authority as may be necessary on such terms
and conditions, as notwithstanding anything contained in any law, it may
determine.

Committee

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
7.
Committees.‑‑An Authority may constitute such Committees as it
may deem necessary for giving effect to the provisions of this Ordinance.

Delegation

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
8.
Delegation.‑‑An Authority may delegate to any person any of its
functions.

Funds

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
9. Funds.‑(1)
The Government may create a fund for an authority to be known by the name of
the Authority which shall vest in the Authority and to which may be credited
all sums received by the Authority.
(2) The fund
shall be kept in such custody and shall be utilized and regulated in such
manner as may be prescribed.

Budget audit and accounts

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
10.
Budget, Audit and Accounts.‑The Government may provide that the
budget of an Authority shall be approved and its accounts shall be maintained
and audited in such manner as may be prescribed.

Public servants

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
11.
Public servants.‑‑All persons acting or purporting to act in
pursuance of any provision of this Ordinance shall be deemed to be public
servants within the meaning of section 21 of the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860.

Rules

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
12.
Rules.‑‑The Government may make rules for carrying out the
purposes of this Ordinance.

Regulations

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
13.
Regulations.‑‑An Authority may with the approval of the
Government make regulations, not inconsistent with the provisions of this
Ordinance and the rules, for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.

Removal of difficulties

ORDINANCE LII OF 1999
ORDINANCE
LII OF 1999
PUNJAB
EDUCATION AUTHORITIES ORDINANCE, 1999
14.
Removal of difficulties.‑If any difficulty arises in giving effect to
any of the provisions of this Ordinance, the Government may give such
directions as it may consider necessary for the removal of such difficulty.
